jamie: hey team :wave: quick question — my 2/28 paycheck shows CA state tax + San Francisco city tax but i moved my primary residence to OR on 2026-02-15. paystub PR-2026-02-874, Employee ID E-7423. can someone take a look?

maria-payroll: thanks for flagging — can you attach a screenshot of the paystub and the address change confirmation you submitted? also did you file the move date with people ops? :eyes:

jamie: attached screenshot (see below). i updated address in the HR portal on 2026-02-16 and uploaded a lease with move-in 2026-02-15. not sure if payroll got the sync.

alex-peopleops: confirmed we received the lease and move form on 2026-02-16. system shows new residential state = OR, effective 2026-02-15. looks like there was a sync error to payroll system. we can share the file and timestamp.

lia-payroll-vendor: we looked at payrun PR-2026-02. our processing log shows the tax jurisdiction was determined from payroll master with ZIP 94107 (San Francisco) for E-7423 at pay calculation time. sample log: 
```
[2026-02-27T22:45:02Z] PR-2026-02 | E-7423 | ZIP_USED=94107 | STATE_CA | CITY=SF | RESIDENCY_EFFECTIVE=2026-02-01
```
It appears the HR->payroll sync had the old zip at cutoff. We can reprocess taxes for that employee for the run if you authorize a retro adjustment.

payroll-bot: Payrun PR-2026-02 completed 2026-03-01 03:04 UTC. Off-cycle adjustments accepted until 2026-03-08 per payroll policy.

maria-payroll: proposed plan: 1) void CA state & city withhold for the payment portion after 2026-02-15, 2) apply OR state withholding for same period, 3) issue a net catch-up payment or tax credit on the next off-cycle payroll depending on net impact. we'll open ticket PAY-4321 and request vendor reprocess. need employee authorization to reverse CA withholdings.

kevin-finance: please add estimated GL impact in the ticket. if vendor issues refunds to payroll, we need to reconcile the CA withholding liability GL and the city tax account — timeline matters for month-end. estimate go-live for the correction?

lia-payroll-vendor: if employee signs authorization, we can re-run tax calculations and produce an off-cycle net adjustment within 5-7 business days. CA refund claim (if needed) typically 4-6 weeks to post. we will provide the JE to kevin-finance.

jamie: i consent to reversing the CA withholdings and reapplying OR. i authorize payroll to reprocess and to share any forms with me to sign. :thumbsup:

maria-payroll: thanks jamie — i've created PAY-4321 and attached the logs + alex's HR timestamp. next steps: lia/vendor to reprocess, vendor to confirm JE lines, maria to confirm off-cycle date. i'll update this thread when PAY-4321 status changes.

alex-peopleops: for W-2 purposes — jamie will be a split-year resident for 2026. payroll: please track move-in/out dates and allocate wages by state when you re-run to ensure state allocations on W-2 show OR from 2026-02-15 forward. we'll also store a copy of the lease in jamie's record.

kevin-finance: ack. i'll review the JE once provided and confirm month-end posting approach. please tag me on PAY-4321.

maria-payroll: vendor confirmed receipt of authorization and has scheduled the reprocess. expected off-cycle net adjustment ETA 2026-03-10. CA refund ETA ~4-6 weeks. closing note: if anyone needs a paper authorization, we can route it to jamie.

jamie: appreciate the quick response everyone. please confirm once the off-cycle posts so i can check my bank. :pray:

maria-payroll: will do — marking this in my queue. PAY-4321 is the canonical ticket. thanks! :white_check_mark:
